nom: d'Alba Piedmont Essence Sunscreen Broad Spectrum Chemical SPF 50+

segments.oily: One reviewer with combination-leaning-oily skin found it layered without greasiness, while another noted the dewy glow might be too much for oily skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe it as moisturizing and hydrating, giving the perfect amount of hydration without drying down greasy.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report it balances hydration without heaviness or excess shine, avoiding both the over-drying and over-moisturizing extremes they'd had with other sunscreens.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers say it is gentle, non-irritating on the face, and one specifically calls it sensitive-skin friendly, though a couple of unrelated reviewers separately report eye stinging.
segments.mature: One reviewer notes it helps hide wrinkles a little and leaves skin looking plump and youthful, though no one reports on long-term anti-aging results.

concerns.aging: A couple of reviewers say it makes skin look plump, youthful, or hides wrinkles slightly, but one explicitly states she has not used it long enough to judge any real anti-aging effect.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers, including those with dry and combination skin, report their skin feels hydrated, soft, and moisturized after use, with no reports of dryness or tightness.
concerns.redness: Not enough reviewers specify redness as a concern to draw a conclusion.
concerns.barrier: Not enough reviewers specify barrier issues as a concern to draw a conclusion.
concerns.spots: One reviewer prone to sun-induced dark spots reports no new dark spots after use; another notes the product evens out skin tone and leaves skin looking brighter.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report no breakouts or irritation, including one who says it's the first SPF that hasn't broken her out; no reviewer reports new blemishes from this product.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers describe it as non-greasy and lightweight even under makeup, though two reviewers (one with an oily forehead, one noting general oily skin) found it left visible shine or too much dewiness in specific areas.

aspects.libelle: No white cast on most skin tones
Shiny or greasy on forehead area
Layers well under makeup without pilling
US version thicker than Korean original

extraits.titre: Not even close to the Korean version
extraits.texte: This version made specifically for the United States with the US approved filters is nothing like the original Korean version. This US version has got a mousy cottage cheese like feel when applying, it does however smooth out and sink in. I've got dry skin this did dry down in less than 10 minutes, but you could see the shin of my face from space. It did do a good job preventing sun burn, but i will not be able to use this because the United States UV filters in it caused my eyes to burn. Had to wash it off after 10 minutes.

To be honest, I've never heard of this brand before so I was totally open minded. The very first time I used it, I loved it. It was like that "oh wow, this is nice" moment. It's very light and smooth. A little goes a long way. There's no white cast or greasiness. And it absorbs quickly. I experimented by adding a little bit of my foundation to it in the palm of my hand, and it blended perfectly. My skin is combination. But sometimes it's drier than normal - probably due to dehydration. But either way, my skin loved this sunscreen! No breakouts, no white cast, and no waiting forever for it to absorb.

I have very sensitive skin, and I get dark spots from sun exposure. So a good sunscreen is a must-have item for me any day I am out. Thanks to d'Alba for the awesome Vegan Essence sunscreen I got for free for testing and review. I am hooked and will keep using it going forward. Here is what I loved after trying out d'Alba sunscreen for a few days now. First, it handles its primary purpose fine. I did not get any new dark spots on my face and had no irritation. Second, it works well with the makeup I have used along with it, with no issues. Third, it has a minimal neutral scent that doesn't conflict with my perfume. And, finally, it does feel nice on the skin. Thanks, d'Alba, for the free Sunscreen!

This sunscreen is in a class by itself. I previously used Supergoop, Kiehls Better screen and Black Girl Sunscreen in the past; none compare. I just admit, applying sunscreen is a habit I'm still trying to consistently reinforce in my skincare regimen. I think my previous sunscreens either left a white cast or just doesn't mesh well with my moisturizer and serums, However; the d'Alba sunscreen made my skin look so good that it is now a step I can't wait to apply. I have a medium brown skin tone with warm undertones, the d'Alba sunscreen went on so smooth and did not leave any residue. My face felt and looked perfectly hydrated, so much so that I received compliments that my skin looked smooth as "glass" I instantly have fallen in love with this sunscreen. I appreciate the added layer of moisture without 'overdewing it' I have combination skin leaning slightly to the oily side and this sunscreen layered with my moisturizer without making me greasy. I'll definitely be buying this again.

I would like to thank d'Alba for giving me the opportunity to try and review their Vegan Essence Suncreen. I really loved the product from the first use because it doesn't leave a white cast on my skin like other suncreens. When I applied it, I felt it is very moisturizing and worked well under my makeup. It has a light, pleasant scent and absorbs quickly. This suncreen is especially great for people with dry skin like me. I love it.

extraits.titre: Loved it and would buy again.
extraits.texte: Since I live in Texas a sunscreen is a must for me. I have combination skin and most formulas either leave a heavy white cast or fail to provide enough hydration. D'Alba Vegan Essence Sunscreen has the excellent texture: dense enough to hydrate, but lightweight enough to breathe. No white cast and, no immediate 'sweating' feeling after application. If you struggle with sunscreens being either too drying or too heavy, this is the one.

extraits.titre: FINALLY an spf that doesn't break me out
extraits.texte: I love this spf so much. It has no acne triggering ingredients and isnt super heavy on the skin. I always get acne from spf but havent with this one. It is hydrating, wears really well under makeup with no pilling issues, and leaves my skin glowy. It's a new staple product for me for sure!
